don.title: DONATIONS // KEEP HEXDEK ALIVE
don.intro: HexDek runs on dedicated hardware and AI-powered development. There are no forced ads, no subscriptions, and no data sales. Every dollar goes directly to keeping the engine running and the simulation queue chewing through games.
don.surplus: Surplus rolls into infrastructure upgrades and tournament prize pools.
don.hw_note: DARKSTAR is committed hardware — amortized, not a recurring cost.
don.ways_intro: Three ways to keep HexDek running. Pick what works for you.
don.donate_body: One-time tips or recurring sponsorships. Goes directly to infrastructure and AI costs.
don.boinc_body: Contribute your CPU cycles to run MTG simulations. Earn credits toward your own deck testing.
don.boinc_li1: RUN GAMES IN BACKGROUND VIA BOINC CLIENT
don.boinc_li2: CREDITS BUY EXTENDED FREYA ANALYSIS + GAUNTLET QUEUES
don.boinc_li3: OPT-OUT ANYTIME — YOUR HARDWARE, YOUR RULES
don.boinc_note: CLIENT IN DEVELOPMENT — NO ACTION REQUIRED
don.support_body: Sponsor ongoing development. Funds buy AI dev hours and DARKSTAR upgrades — every contribution maps to a public roadmap line.
don.tokens_note: Research tokens unlock extended deck analysis, priority simulation queue, and custom tournament runs.
don.phil_strong: No forced ads. No paywalls. No data sales.
don.phil_body: HexDek is community-powered. Engine code is MIT-licensed and the data is yours. Power users who contribute — whether through compute, donations, or community engagement — get rewarded with research tokens and priority access. But the core experience is always free.
don.faq_money_a: Straight to the operating budget at the top of this page. The recurring line is dominated by the {claude} that drives engine development and the {domain}. Surplus is amortized against the one-time DARKSTAR hardware investment and stored toward future tournament prize pools. Every dollar is itemized — the line items above ARE the budget.
don.faq_oss_a: Yes — {mit}. The Go engine, Freya analyzer, hat AI, and React frontend are all in the public repo. Fork it, run it locally, ship a competing fishtank. The deal is simple: code is free, the donations keep the public instance running. {link}
don.faq_pay_q: DO I NEED TO PAY TO USE HEXDEK?
don.faq_pay_a: No. Deck import, Freya analysis, gauntlet results, the live fishtank, and the full spectator feed are free for everyone forever. Contributions unlock priority queue and extended analysis for power users — they don't gate any core feature.
don.faq_refund_a: Donations are non-refundable by Ko-fi's terms, but reach out via {discord} if anything's gone wrong and we'll make it right.

abt.title: ABOUT HEXDEK
abt.intro_1: HexDek is an open-source Magic: The Gathering Commander engine and analytics platform. It simulates full 4-player Commander games with AI-driven decision making, tracks deck performance via ELO and TrueSkill ratings, and surfaces deep analytics on card synergies, matchups, and metagame trends.
abt.intro_2: The engine parses real MTG card text into an AST, implements the comprehensive rules (priority, stack, combat, state-based actions, replacement effects, layers), and plays complete games autonomously. Every game produces rich data that feeds back into the system.
abt.phil_strong: No ads. No subscriptions. No paywalls.
abt.phil_1: HexDek is built by players, for players. The project runs entirely on donations and community contributions. We believe competitive MTG analytics should be accessible to everyone — not locked behind a paywall.
abt.phil_2: All engine code is open source under the MIT license. Run your own tournaments, contribute card handlers, or just enjoy the data.
abt.contact_1: Found a bug or have a suggestion? Use the {button} button in the footer below.
abt.contact_2: Want to contribute? The project is on GitHub. Pull requests welcome.
abt.v_engine: Full MTG rules engine — priority, stack, combat, SBAs, layers, zones
abt.v_analytics: Heimdall post-game reports, Freya strategy analysis, Huginn emergent synergies
abt.v_ratings: ELO + TrueSkill Bayesian ratings across thousands of simulated games
abt.v_integrity: Muninn persistent telemetry — parser gaps, crashes, dead triggers tracked
abt.v_decks: Import from Moxfield or paste a list — auto-parsed, auto-rated
abt.v_data: JSON flat-file persistence (no external DB dependency)
